title: The Frankfort Boat Club Inc.
specs: Located on the Kentucky River at downtown Frankfort with historical significance
Access to boating, fishing, and river activities in Pool 4 of the Kentucky River
Vessels must carry minimum liability insurance
Membership includes a 25-hour annual maintenance commitment or buyout at $30/hr

blurb: The Frankfort Boat Club is a private, member-run cooperative dedicated to safe boating on the Kentucky River. Members have access to docks, restrooms, and shower facilities at 101 Riverboat Landing. The club operates on a cooperative model requiring member labor or a buyout for maintenance hours.
extraNote: Membership is cooperative and member-run with volunteer leadership · Non-members must be accompanied by an active member at all times on docks or vessels · 101 Riverboat Landing, Frankfort, KY
